row_materialization.scenario_template: Complete {change}:{task_id} and verify its authoritative acceptance statement.

evidence_layers.unit: Focused owning-logic or artifact-policy test selected exactly once.
evidence_layers.integration: Changed crate, database, filesystem, process, or service boundary.
evidence_layers.e2e: Changed CLI, MCP, installer, or other public workflow.
evidence_layers.platform: Every affected supported operating-system or packaging boundary.
evidence_layers.property: Generated invariants for identities, ordering, bounds, or serialization.
evidence_layers.fuzz: Malformed or adversarial input at parser, migration, path, or protocol boundaries.
evidence_layers.benchmark: Pinned comparative evidence for performance, resource, accuracy, or agent claims.
evidence_layers.packaged_smoke: Actually installed release artifact exercised through real CLI and stdio MCP against project-local SQLite populated from a small real repository.

unit_test.assertion: The binding registry passes, while empty inventories, duplicate capability IDs, blank owners, unknown packs, empty public surfaces, empty fixtures, blank acceptance rules, and a reduced four-platform matrix all fail without trusting a copied capability total.
covered_inputs: capability rows and declared count reconciliation
Windows, Linux, macOS arm64, and macOS x86-64 platform identities

stable_row_overrides.scenario: The live candidate and adversarial in-memory mutations are checked against fixed capability IDs, standard-name aliases, dialect distinctions, parser reuse, ownership, fixtures, platforms, evidence state, and digest.

unit_test.assertion: The valid pending candidate passes, while count-only parity, a missing required entry, duplicate IDs, fake aliases, absent fixtures/owners/platforms, inconsistent shared-parser ownership, count-preserving fake parser reuse, unsupported claims, and current-mode shrinkage all fail.
covered_inputs: per-mode ownership, fixtures, and four-platform matrix

unit_test.assertion: The valid ten-family registry and its per-capability ownership/acceptance data pass; removing a required family, installing the optional semantic pack by default, or making default core optional fails.

recorded CLI and MCP schema/default families
runtime identity and local replay evidence
explicit complete-default, exact-golden, error-replay, and hosted-replay gaps

ProjectAtlas source, Cargo.lock, runner, executable, command, and environment bindings

three warmups and fifteen registered repetitions
